about: Modwerk's Model:Cycles OS 1.13 base, built by npm run machine:base -- model-cycles: core-mc 0.3's source from Elekloader v0.11.0, unchanged (sdk/imports/core-mc-source-f20ffda.json). Modwerk adds ev_key_leds (base/key-leds.s), the key-LED frame, as the Digitakt II has it: one source, one site and its collection. The base keeps everything of the core-mc 0.3 release. A collection's number is its entry size in bytes (a handler's address), not a count: the linker puts every subscriber in the hook's table.

dev.about: The development link (base/link.c, link.s): identity and memory reads over USB MIDI SysEx, after the Analog Rytm MKII's. Read-only for now. Any USB host can reach it: development bases only.
